pr_title: Separate underscore from grapheme punctuation to enable doubleclick and caret jump over snakecase variables in editor
pr_body:
Separate underscore from grapheme punctuation to enable doubleclick and caret jump over snakecase variables in editor.

I noticed that due to commit 06ae77a the method "shaped_text_get_word_breaks" now breaks on underscores (aka _ ), which means that a doubleclick on the editor window on a snake_case variable with_underscores_like_this will only select part of it (word by word split by the underscores) instead of the whole variable. The same thing also happens on ctrl+arrows to move the caret right or left. This is different from how godot 3.2, VSCode and other IDEs handle snake_case doubleclick and caret movement.

I mentioned this in 46524 and also patched my fork of godot with this code to have it do what I expected: to select the entire snake_case variables with doubleclick and skip the entire variable on ctrl+arrow by splitting underscores from the GRAPHEME_IS_PUNCTUATION logic, and created a new enum entry GRAPHEME_IS_UNDERSCORE and added this as a parameter to shaped_text_get_word_breaks so that the method can be reused if someone wishes for a different logic.

Hopefully this is good enough for the master godot repository, but I am happy to know if a different solution is better. 


*Bugsquad edit:* Fixes #46456, fixes #46380.
pr_comments: @Calinou then would you say that the desired solution is to have an exposed editor setting with a list of what chars should be considered for a word break (aka nonwordcharacter on atom), and replace the punctuation logic with a check from this list in a manner similar to #46721 ?
Thanks for the reviews! I have updated the code to include them.

issue_context.title: Regression with Contextual Help lookup
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**

4.0 master (75d03f1fbd94efb5f8756e405de03cf271435336)


**OS/device including version:**

macOS 10.14.6


**Issue description:**

When the script editor cursor is on a word with a `_`, the lookup does not used the entire word.

**Steps to reproduce:**

Open the attached project, open *Main.gd*, place the cursor on the `node` part of `find_node` (without selecting anything), then bring up the contextual help.

The docs will be on `node` when it should be on `find_node`.

This works properly in 3.2.4rc. `TextEdit::get_word_under_cursor()` has been re-implemented on master which breaks this behaviour.

**Minimal reproduction project:**

[ContextHelpBug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/6052186/ContextHelpBug.zip)

review_comments: nitpicking but seeing the other checks, should we have an is_underscore(c) function here that checks this? Probably overkill but I can see there may be a reason alternatives to underscores are added at some point.
It seems there is one in `text_server_fb` so it should likely be added here too for consistency.
ah, thanks, I didn't see that there was a method for this check
